news: Wheels Up signed as launch customer for Surf Air's Enterprise BrokerOS, a 2-3 year deal worth up to $12M in subscription revenue.
New Chairman Shawn Pelsinger takes over July 24, 2026, following the expanded Palantir-backed SurfOS push and a debt refinance that cut convertible principal from ~$47M to $16.9M.
Liquidity remains thin (current ratio ~0.2) even as deals accumulate; today's -5.7% move looks like give-back after an early-July ~36% pre-market spike on the Palantir news.

Stock fell further today (-9.4%, the portfolio's biggest mover) as the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index dropped 6.3% on reports Meta is building a service to resell excess AI computing capacity, pressuring AI-infrastructure names broadly.
CEO recently warned of 'pretty significant delays' in AI industry buildout timelines through 2026-2027, compounding customer-concentration concerns at the Polaris Forge campus.
Q4 FY26 earnings call set for July 27, 2026; Street remains Strong Buy (avg target ~$73) despite a technical 'Strong Sell' momentum signal.
Continuing push into healthcare (Diligent Robotics acquisition) and laundry delivery; shares have lost roughly half their value in 2026 and are down ~25% over the past three months.
Q1 2026 revenue grew 578% YoY to $3M but operating expenses more than tripled, driving a $49M quarterly net loss (following a $101.3M loss in 2025); $197.4M cash on hand as of March 31.
Full-year 2026 revenue guidance reaffirmed at $26M; still deep in cash-burn phase while scaling autonomous delivery.

FDA's Pharmacy Compounding Advisory Committee meets July 23-24, 2026 to review seven peptides (including BPC-157 and TB-500) tied to Hims' branded peptide push -- a binary regulatory catalyst for that revenue line.

Early-July rally to $37.57 came on a new $400M JPMorgan receivables facility plus price-target hikes (BofA to $36, Canaccord to $40); today's -7.2% pullback has no identified company-specific cause, reading as broad-market/momentum-name give-back.
No new negative company-specific news found for today's drop.
Q2 2026 earnings due after market close July 22, 2026 (6 days out) -- consensus EPS $0.86 (+4.9% YoY), revenue $3.92B (+22% YoY).
Stock is down ~51% over the past year despite 77% gross margins; sell-side remains split, with targets ranging from $130 (Benchmark/Oppenheimer) to $236 (Bernstein).
S&P Global downgraded Oracle's credit rating to BBB- on July 9, citing OpenAI customer concentration (~half of the $638B backlog) and a projected -$42B free cash flow in FY27.

Oracle plans to raise $40-50B in capital, including ~$20B in new equity, to defend its investment-grade rating -- a dilution overhang; stock hit a fresh 52-week low this week, down ~50% from its September 2025 high.
Despite the downgrade, 37 of 43 analysts still rate it Buy; today's -4.6% move continues the post-downgrade slide.
